scientific_integrity: The all-length formula and asymptotics have proofs; finite checks independently enumerate all words through length 11 and a mask-DP through length 80. Novelty is qualified by broader algorithmic prior work and incomplete global literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Only three-letter adjacent-distinct linear words under fixed-alphabet subsequence universality.
Potential equivalent statements in unindexed literature; no independent audit performed.
title: Exact universality-index law for homopolymer-free ternary words
